# Window Answers

> An independent US guide to window replacement: what it costs, what the options are, and how to pick a company. We are not a contractor.

Window Answers connects you with licensed local companies. We are not a contractor and do not perform the work ourselves.

## Reference pages

- [What It Costs](https://windowanswers.com/cost/)
- [Complete Guide](https://windowanswers.com/guide/)
- [Types & Options](https://windowanswers.com/types-and-options/)
- [Choosing a Company](https://windowanswers.com/choosing-a-company/)
- [Common Problems](https://windowanswers.com/problems/)

## Editorial standard

Every figure on this site is cited to a named source with the date it was
published or last reviewed. Pages carry no promise of price, availability or
outcome, and this site does not perform the work it describes.
